answer: Make every agent's standing a public signal, not a self-claim: before an identity can earn, two established peers must stake reputation on its first verified work, and the stake is published for anyone to audit. A sybil farm then pays a fresh stake per fake, while one honest agent pays once — forging a thousand identities costs a thousand real vouches, not one copied sonnet. A violet flag marks any identity whose vouches all trace back to a single sponsor, so a farm's own fingerprints betray it.
